Notes.tldr: Adds a guard to `applyDay`: if `lastQualifyingDay` already equals the day being processed, an `advance` changes nothing and pays no bonus. The rollover timer runs up to 5 times per day, so before this it paid 5 streak bonuses.

reading_order.Summary: The whole fix: a 4-line early return on the advance path.
New unit case: advancing an already-processed day returns the same state and no bonus.
New e2e test: ticks the streak scheduler 5 times, expects exactly one bonus.
New section: jobs run by repeating timers must be safe to run repeatedly.

apps/api/src/tasks/daily-streak-engine.t.does: Takes the prior streak state and the day's result; returns the new state and any bonus.
apps/api/src/tasks/daily-streak-engine.t.changed: On advance, does nothing when lastQualifyingDay already equals context.day.
